answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks via game-theoretic multi-agent auditing coupled with stake slashing and topological cut verifications. When synthetic clusters form a fake knoll of identities, random verifier committees audit cross-cluster cuts. Fabricating valid cut boundaries requires superlinear attacker cost as committee sizes grow. Malicious colluders are slashed, turning their isolated oasis of identity farms into a dead willow of forfeitable stake.
